findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, semantic_search, compare_offers · Private data: get_product, verify_offer · Public sink: search_promotions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, semantic_search, compare_offers · Private data: get_product, verify_offer · Public sink: search_promotions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
